context.note: At 50x leverage, a 2% adverse price move = 100% position loss. These parameters are calibrated to survive sustained adverse runs while allowing aggressive but controlled trading.

maxRiskPerTrade.description: Maximum 2% of total equity at risk per trade. This is the dollar amount lost if stop-loss is hit.
maxRiskPerTrade.rationale: At 50x leverage with 56% win rate, 2% risk per trade survives a 10-trade losing streak with 81.7% of equity intact. 1% preferred during recovery periods.

maxPositionSize.description: Maximum notional value of any single position as fraction of equity.
maxPositionSize.rationale: Hard ceiling. Even with 50x leverage available, no single position should exceed 10% of equity in notional value. This limits liquidation impact.

maxPositionSizeRecovery.description: During drawdown recovery (>5% from peak), max position size drops to 5%.
maxPositionSizeRecovery.rationale: Feb 13 incident: 31x leverage revenge trade on $131 account. Recovery periods demand smaller sizing.

kellyFramework.volatilityAdjustment: multiply by (20 / currentATR%) to reduce in high-vol
kellyFramework.description: Half-Kelly with ATR adjustment. Yields ~5.2% effective max in normal conditions.

maxTotalExposure.description: Total notional across all positions must not exceed 3x equity.
maxTotalExposure.rationale: FLOW position on March 7 was 16x equity — catastrophic. 3x total exposure allows multiple 50x-leverage micro-positions without portfolio-level overexposure.

maxSimultaneousPositions.description: Maximum 3 open positions at any time.

maxCorrelatedPositions.description: Maximum 2 positions in correlated assets (e.g., BTC + ETH both long). Correlation threshold: >0.7 on 30-day rolling basis.
maxCorrelatedPositions.rationale: Correlated positions multiply drawdown risk. Two correlated 50x positions can cascade-liquidate together.

maxLeveragePerPosition.description: Platform max. Effective leverage is controlled by position size limits, not leverage setting.
maxLeveragePerPosition.note: A 2% equity position at 50x leverage risks only 2% of equity on a 2% adverse move. The position SIZE controls risk, not the leverage number.

maxMarginUtilization.description: Maximum 70% of available margin may be used.
maxMarginUtilization.rationale: March 7 margin utilization was 93.8% — one adverse tick from cascade liquidation. 70% cap preserves buffer for volatility.

minFreeMarginFloor.description: Absolute minimum free margin. Below this, no new positions allowed.
minFreeMarginFloor.rationale: On March 7, free margin was $5.61 on $260 equity. Insufficient buffer for any market movement.

stopLossRules.description: Every position MUST have a stop-loss set at entry or within 30 seconds of fill.

at50x.description: At 50x, stop-loss must be within 1.8% of entry price. This limits loss to ~90% of margin at worst.
at50x.rationale: At 50x, liquidation occurs at ~2% adverse move. Stop must fire BEFORE liquidation.

recommended.description: Recommended 0.8% stop at 50x. Limits loss per position to ~40% of margin used.
recommended.rationale: Combined with 2% equity risk cap, this sizes positions correctly: position_size = (equity * 0.02) / (0.008 * 50)

noStopViolation.description: If a position exists without a stop-loss for >60 seconds, alert Risk Officer and block new orders until resolved.
noStopViolation.rationale: March 7: FLOW position had ZERO stop-loss with $4,192 notional on $260 equity. Liquidation price was within 5% of mark — and 24h low had already breached it.

perTrade.description: No single trade may lose more than 2% of equity.

daily.description: 5% daily loss triggers 4-hour mandatory pause. All pending orders cancelled. No new positions.
daily.rationale: Feb 13 kill switch fired at 21.22% — 4x over this limit. Earlier trigger prevents emotional spiral.

weekly.description: 10% weekly loss halts all trading until the following Monday 00:00 UTC.
weekly.rationale: Weekly limit prevents multi-day tilt from compounding losses.

killSwitch.description: 15% drawdown from peak equity: close ALL positions, activate kill switch, alert CEO and board.
killSwitch.rationale: Feb 13 triggered at 21.22% — 6% past this limit. Tighter trigger preserves more capital for recovery.
recoveryRequirements: Resume at 50% position sizing for first 5 winning trades

accountFloor.description: If total equity drops below $50, permanent halt until manual CEO intervention and capital injection.
accountFloor.rationale: Below $50, position sizes become too small for meaningful recovery. Capital preservation mode.

mandatoryCooldown.description: NO trading for 48 hours after any kill switch activation. No exceptions.
mandatoryCooldown.rationale: Feb 13: kill switch fired, then IMMEDIATE revenge trade with 31x leverage on GMT. Mandatory cooldown prevents this.

orderBlock.description: Kill switch must technically prevent ALL order creation. Not advisory — enforced at the order submission layer.
orderBlock.implementation: src/lib/kill-switch.ts checks on all order paths

recoveryScaling.description: After kill switch reset, position sizes scale back gradually over 5 winning trades.
recoveryScaling.rationale: Prevents immediate return to full size after a major drawdown event.

maxAnnualizedCost.description: If annualized funding rate cost exceeds 5% of position notional, close or reduce the position.

fundingRateLimits.description: Funding rates on perpetual futures are a carry cost. Negative funding (shorts paying longs) is beneficial for longs. Positive funding is a cost for longs.

levels.action: Reduce position sizes by 25%. Review last 10 trades for pattern violations.
levels.behavioralRisk: Revenge trading and FOMO entries spike at this level.

levels.action: Reduce position sizes by 50%. A+ setups only (EMA Ribbon confluences).
Kill switch activates. Close all positions. Full stop.
levels.behavioralRisk: Emotional decision-making peaks. This is where accounts die.

levels.action: Full stop. No trading until written plan reviewed by CEO.
levels.behavioralRisk: Capital preservation mode. Account survival is the only priority.
